scripts.text: In the Lab today, in the Lab tomorrow! Everyday is filled with research! Even if it takes my entire life, I will not give up until I have made a new Juno...
scripts.translation: 今天在实验室，明天也在实验室！每天都在做研究！即使耗尽一生，我也不会放弃，直到造出一座新的朱诺...

scripts.text: A new Juno in which all will bask in the light of my genius! If I can just harness the power of flight... I know I can do it!
scripts.translation: 我要造一座全新的朱诺，让所有人都沐浴在我的天才光芒中！只要能掌握飞行的力量...我一定能做到！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Wagan^000000 said that my idea was crazy and impossible. But I am no fool, I won't be swayed by his words of mockery!
scripts.translation: ^FF0000瓦甘说我^000000的想法很疯狂，不可能实现。但我不是傻瓜，我不会被他嘲讽的话语动摇！

scripts.text: I'm going to ask my colleague ^FF0000Stangckle^000000 to help me. I am sure he will be more than willing to help out an old friend.
scripts.translation: 我要请我的同事斯^FF0000坦克尔来^000000帮忙。我相信他一定会乐意帮助一位老朋友的。

scripts.text: If I had that fellow's help, this would be much easier. Pray! Pray to whatever God you believe that we will succeed!
scripts.translation: 如果那家伙肯帮忙，事情就容易多了。祈祷吧！向你信仰的神明祈祷，愿我们成功！

scripts.text: What? That punk Stangckle said he doesn't want to help me?! This is not good. This will slow my research considerably.
scripts.translation: 什么？那个混混斯坦克尔说不想帮我？！这可不好。这会大大拖慢我的研究进度。

scripts.text: Luckily, I have a back up plan. I am positive that my friend and colleague ^FF0000Kato^000000 will lend his aid.
scripts.translation: 幸好，我还有备用计划。我确信我的朋友兼同事加^0^FF00000000^0000000藤会伸出援手。

scripts.text: If I can only study his super robot, Great Z, I can continue my research...
scripts.translation: 只要我能研究一下他的超级机器人，大Z，我就能继续我的研究...

scripts.text: I guess if Stangckle doesn't want to help me, he can have it his way. I must continue my research, whether or not he helps me.
scripts.translation: 看来如果斯坦克尔不想帮我，那就随他去吧。无论他帮不帮我，我都必须继续我的研究。

scripts.text: Expect great things, young friend. Muahahahha.
scripts.translation: 期待着吧，年轻的朋友。哇哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: What? You mean to tell me that the very thing I need to continue my research, the mighty Great Z, has been destroyed?!!
scripts.translation: 什么？你是说，我继续研究所必需的强大机器“大Z”被毁掉了？！

scripts.text: Nooooo~!! Why? Why would they do that? Are the Gods cursing me?!
scripts.translation: 不——！！为什么？为什么他们要这么做？是诸神在诅咒我吗？！

scripts.text: If I can just get the help of professor ^FF0000CiCi^000000 with his Riding Engine theory, I might be able to finish my research...
scripts.translation: 如果我能得到教授西西^FF0000的骑乘^000000引擎理论帮助，或许就能完成我的研究...

scripts.text: How can this happen 3 times in a row? Its true, the Gods have forsaken me! I'm ruined... RUINED!!!
scripts.translation: 怎么会连续三次都这样？看来诸神真的抛弃我了！我完蛋了...彻底完蛋了！！！

scripts.text: What can I do now...? Has the time really come for me to forfeit all my years of research?
scripts.translation: 我现在该怎么办...？难道真的到了放弃多年研究成果的时候了吗？

scripts.text: I know I've disappointed you, but please, forget all about me.
scripts.translation: 我知道我让你失望了，但求你，忘了我吧。

scripts.text: Who would do this to me? What kind of malicious person would shatter a man's dreams??
scripts.translation: 是谁这样对我？到底是什么恶人，竟然粉碎了一个人的梦想？！

scripts.text: I'm tired of this. I think that the time has come for me to give up. It's all over. Please don't be too disappointed...
scripts.translation: 我受够了。我想是时候放弃了。一切都结束了。请不要太失望...

scripts.text: Maybe I should look into a job change. I hear it is a popular decision these days.
scripts.translation: 也许我该考虑一下转职。听说最近这很流行。

scripts.text: I wonder what I should look into? All I know for sure is that I don't want to be scientist anymore. I'm done with research...
scripts.translation: 我该研究些什么好呢？我只确定一件事，我不想再当科学家了。我厌倦了研究...

scripts.text: I better get going to check this new thing out. What are you still doing here? I'll be leaving in a bit.
scripts.translation: 我得赶紧去看看这个新东西。你还待在这里干什么？我过一会儿就走。

scripts.text: I need to get ready! You go ahead and take off, I'll be going out soon.
scripts.translation: 我得准备一下！你先去吧，我马上就来。

scripts.text: I'm sure that you know our city has been living off our research for many years.
scripts.translation: 我想你也知道，我们这座城市多年来一直靠研究成果发展。

scripts.text: We owe this quality of life to those who have dedicated their lives to research and study.
scripts.translation: 我们能过上这样的生活，要感谢那些毕生致力于研究的人。

scripts.text: So we help each other and study together. It is nice to have such solid support around when we are conducting research.
scripts.translation: 所以大家互相帮助、共同研究。做研究时，有这么多人坚定地支持彼此，真好。

scripts.text: But there are those few bad apples that just drive me crazy...
scripts.translation: 但总有那么几个害群之马，真是让我头疼...

scripts.text: It's good to try hard, but there are those selfish and crazy mad scientists that make things harder for the rest of us.
scripts.translation: 努力尝试是好事，但有些自私又疯狂的科学家让其他人的处境变得更艰难。

scripts.text: Out of all those, ^FF0000Metto^000000 must be the worst by far. He's into crazy things...
scripts.translation: 在所有这些人^FF0000中，梅托^000000肯定是最糟糕的。他总搞些疯狂的事情...

scripts.text: For science, he's destroyed public facilities, has been the cause of noise and air pollution and generally disturbing the peace...
scripts.translation: 为了科学，他破坏公共设施，造成噪音和空气污染，还总是扰乱大家的安宁...

scripts.text: And he's justifying his behavior under the excuse of research! He's a crazy fellow who's taken it too far!
scripts.translation: 他还以研究为借口为自己的行为辩护！他是个走火入魔的疯子！

scripts.text: I wish there was a way that we could stop him from wrecking it for the rest of us. Some brave, daring soul should be able to do something...
scripts.translation: 我真希望有办法阻止他继续破坏大家的生活...总该有个勇敢无畏的人能做点什么...

scripts.text: I wish your village luck in doing so.
Thanks for the offer, but I don't think this is something that you could do...
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的提议，但我觉得这事你办不到...

scripts.text: I think we need someone a bit harsher to help us out. I think it would be a little too much for a Novice.
scripts.translation: 我觉得需要更强硬的人来帮忙。初心者恐怕难以胜任。

scripts.text: Oh, are you going to take care of this for us? We would be very grateful.
scripts.translation: 哦，你要为我们处理这件事吗？我们会非常感激的。

scripts.text: But how do you plan to go about doing this? I'm guessing it's harder than it sounds...
scripts.translation: 但你打算怎么做？我猜这事比听起来难得多...

scripts.text: Of course I have a plan.
I guess I need a plan.
I have faith in you. You should know that he believes in fate. Use that to your advantage.
scripts.translation: 我相信你。你应该知道，他很相信命运。好好利用这一点。

scripts.text: I feel much better knowing you will take care of this little problem...
scripts.translation: 知道你会处理这个小麻烦，我感觉好多了...

scripts.text: Hmmm... I admire your zeal, but how do you expect to accomplish anything without a plan?
scripts.translation: 嗯...我佩服你的热情，但没有计划，你打算怎么完成这件事？

scripts.text: You need a ruse to trick him into quitting. Something subtle, like... Hmm...
scripts.translation: 你得设个计策骗他放弃。要巧妙些，比如...嗯...

scripts.text: ...Sabotaging his experiments and making it look like it was his destiny to fail!
scripts.translation: ...破坏他的实验，再让他以为失败就是他的命运！

scripts.text: He's talkative, so if you approach him, he'll tell you all you need to know.
scripts.translation: 他话很多，如果你接近他，他会告诉你你需要知道的一切。

scripts.text: I've been thinking of this plan for a while...
scripts.translation: ..我考虑这个计划已经有一段时间了...

scripts.text: We will have to pray for fate to help us. Now to think of it, Metto is a strong believer in fate.
scripts.translation: 我们得祈求命运助我们一臂之力。说起来，梅托很相信命运。

scripts.text: If only we could use that to our advantage...
scripts.translation: 如果我们能利用这一点就好了...

scripts.text: Thank you for your help. Because of your work in ridding us of Metto, we have one less worry.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的帮助。多亏你帮我们摆脱了梅托，我们少了一桩烦心事。

scripts.text: I'm sure the people of Juno are very thankful. Here is a little token of our appreciation...
scripts.translation: 朱诺的居民一定很感激。这是我们的一点谢意...

scripts.text: Oh no, it seems that you are carrying too much stuff! Would you make some room?
scripts.translation: 糟糕，你携带的东西太多了！能腾出点空间吗？

scripts.text: I wish you luck in your future endeavors...
scripts.translation: 祝你在未来的冒险中好运...

scripts.text: Oh no, it seems that you are carrying too much! Would you make some room?
scripts.translation: 糟糕，你携带的东西太多了！能腾出点空间吗？

scripts.text: I wish you luck in your future endeavors...
scripts.translation: 祝你在未来的冒险中好运...

scripts.text: Things around here seem much more peaceful without that Metto around. Thanks for your help.
scripts.translation: 梅托不在这里捣乱，周围似乎平静多了。谢谢你帮忙。

scripts.text: How goes your work with Metto? Hopefully the plan is going well. I'm sorry to bother you with such a task.
scripts.translation: 你和梅托的事进展如何？希望计划进行顺利。抱歉给你添了这样的麻烦。

scripts.text: What can I do for you? My colleague Metto is coming here soon, so I don't have much time. So what did you say you needed?
scripts.translation: 有什么可以帮你的吗？我的同事梅托马上就要来了，所以我没多少时间。你说你需要什么来着？

scripts.text: I'm here to stop your research.
Is that true?? Metto doesn't think of me as a colleague, but still wants me to help him?!
scripts.translation: 真的吗？！梅托不把我当同事，却还想让我帮他？！

scripts.text: He only sees me as an assistant and is going to steal all the credit for our discoveries?!
scripts.translation: 他只把我当助手，还想独占我们所有发现的功劳？！

scripts.text: This guy can't be trusted! The rumors were true: he really is mad!
scripts.translation: 这家伙信不过！传言果然没错：他真疯了！

scripts.text: And to think, I really respected that traitor! I can't even stand to see that guy's face anymore.
scripts.translation: 没想到，我竟然那么尊重那个叛徒！我现在连看他的脸都受不了了。

scripts.text: I'm glad that an honest, trustworthy person such as yourself had the guts to tell me. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 幸好你这样诚实可靠的人有勇气告诉我真相。谢谢你。

scripts.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I have work to do.
scripts.translation: 那么，失陪了，我还有工作要做。

scripts.text: What are you doing then? Stop wasting my time.
scripts.translation: 那你到底在干什么？别浪费我的时间。

scripts.text: I am one of the scientists in this city. My name is Stangckle.
scripts.translation: 我是这座城里的科学家之一。我叫斯坦克尔。

scripts.text: You should remember my name, it may be useful to you in the future.
scripts.translation: 你应该记住我的名字，将来可能会对你有用。

scripts.text: I am one of the scientists in this city. My name is Stangckle.
scripts.translation: 我是这座城里的科学家之一。我叫斯坦克尔。

scripts.text: You should remember my name, it may be useful to you in the future.
scripts.translation: 你应该记住我的名字，将来可能会对你有用。

scripts.text: So Metto has become one of those mad scientists. I guess that is the choice he has ultimately made for his life.
scripts.translation: 看来梅托成了那种疯狂科学家。我想，这就是他最终选择的人生道路。

scripts.text: I am a scientist researching all sorts of things.
scripts.translation: 我是一名研究各种领域的科学家。

scripts.text: Of course, my research is private and confidential. But is there anything I can do for you?
scripts.translation: 当然，我的研究是保密的。不过，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I want to stop you from making a mistake.
What? Metto said, my Great Z is inferior to Stangckles research?!
scripts.translation: 什么？梅托说我的“大Z”比不上斯坦克尔的研究？！

scripts.text: H-he said I should rename my invention to 'Lame Z?' *Sniff* I... I don't believe it... *Sob*
scripts.translation: 他...他说我应该把发明改名叫“烂Z”？*吸吸鼻子* 我...我不相信...*呜呜*

scripts.text: I-If my invention is no good, then I guess I should destroy my Great Z... *sigh*
scripts.translation: 如...如果我的发明不怎么样，那我想我该毁掉我的“大Z”... *叹气*

scripts.text: Thank you for letting me know. I know it wasn't easy to tell me.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你告诉我。我知道这对你来说并不容易开口。

scripts.text: I am interested in researching artificial intelligence. You know, like robots.
scripts.translation: 我对人工智能很感兴趣。你知道的，比如机器人。

scripts.text: I know it a very difficult feat to accomplish, but where there's a will, there's a way.
scripts.translation: 我知道这非常难做到，但世上无难事，只怕有心人。

scripts.text: If you ever see something really amazing like this, you'll know its my handiwork.
scripts.translation: 如果你以后看到像这样真正惊人的东西，你就知道那是我的杰作。

scripts.text: I am a scientist of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics.
scripts.translation: 我是一名研究人工智能和机器人的科学家。

scripts.text: I don't have a specific project right now, but my latest creation, the 'Great Z,' is truly a product of sheer and utter genius.
scripts.translation: 我现在没有具体项目，不过我最新的发明“大Z”确实是十足天才的杰作。

scripts.text: My name is CiCi. I am one of the three great scientists in this city.
scripts.translation: 我叫西西。我是这座城市三大科学家之一。

scripts.text: There are many great scientists in this city, but being in the top three is a true honor. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation: 这座城市有很多伟大的科学家，但能进入前三可是真正的荣誉。你不觉得吗？

scripts.text: Well, I think I've bragged a little too much now, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我觉得我吹牛吹得有点多了，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Hm? Metto said that he doesn't need my Riding Engine theory?! Hmpf, what an ingrate!
scripts.translation: 嗯？梅托说他不需要我的骑乘引擎理论？！哼，真是忘恩负义！

scripts.text: I have half a mind to teach him a little something about true science and intelligent research.
scripts.translation: 我真想教教他，什么才是真正的科学和严谨的研究。

scripts.text: He thinks that I owe him an apology?! For what? Why should I apologize...?!
scripts.translation: 他觉得我该向他道歉？！凭什么？我为什么要道歉...？！

scripts.text: Whatever, I really didn't have the necessary parts to help him anyway. I guess, either way, he would not have had a chance.
scripts.translation: 算了，反正我也没有必要的零件来帮他。我想，无论如何，他都没戏。

scripts.text: Let him know I really don't want to be a part of what he is doing. He isn't even doing the type of research that we would be able to publicize.
scripts.translation: 告诉他，我一点也不想掺和他在做的事。他的研究根本不适合公开发表。

scripts.text: What? That's it? I was bored before you came, but you've managed to bore me even more.
scripts.translation: 什么？就这？你来之前我就很无聊了，你倒好，让我更无聊了。

scripts.text: My name is CiCi. I am one of the three great scientists in this city.
scripts.translation: 我叫西西。我是这座城市三大科学家之一。

scripts.text: There are many great scientists here, but being in the top three is a true honor, wouldn't you agree?
scripts.translation: 这里有很多优秀的科学家，但能跻身前三可是莫大的荣誉，你说呢？

scripts.text: I want to improve the Riding Engine in a new way, but I lack the parts I need...
scripts.translation: .我想用一种新的方式来改进骑乘引擎，但我缺少需要的零件...

scripts.text: What a headache~ And Metto has never offered me any help at all. This will not be easy.
scripts.translation: 真是让人头疼~ 而且梅托从来没有给过我任何帮助。这可不容易啊。

scripts.text: Oh ho ho... These are the parts that I needed. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation: 哦呵呵...这些正是我需要的零件。非常感谢。

scripts.text: Okay, let's try this out! Hold on for just a second!
scripts.translation: 好了，让我们来试试！请稍等片刻！

scripts.translation: 穆^3355FF里尼尔印章？^000000真是令人惊讶！

scripts.text: When you go East from the entrance of Juno, you will find the Street of Book Stores. If you have some time, please visit ^3355FFSir Yklah^000000 who is one of 3 well-known sages in Juno.
scripts.translation: 从朱诺入口往东走，你会找到书店街。有空的话，请去拜访伊克拉，他是^^3355FF0000^00000000朱诺三位著名贤者之一。

scripts.text: I believe he may take some special interest in the Stamp you are carrying.
scripts.translation: 我想他可能会对你携带的印章产生特别的兴趣。

scripts.text: In Juno, you can visit places such as the 'Juphero Plaza,' 'Juno Conference Hall,' 'Schweicherbil Magic Academy', or the 'Monster Museum.' These places are famous around the world!
scripts.translation: 在朱诺，你可以参观“朱菲罗广场”、“朱诺会议厅”、“施韦切尔比尔魔法学院”或“魔物博物馆”。这些地方都闻名遐迩！

scripts.text: You may also wish to drop by the 'Sage Castle,' where people can change their jobs into 'Sage,' one of the more unique classes.
scripts.translation: 你也可以去“贤者城堡”看看，那里可以将职业转职为“贤者”，这是一种比较独特的职业。

scripts.text: If you're interested in the Sage class, why don't you go look around the castle?
scripts.translation: 如果你对贤者职业感兴趣，不妨去城堡里转转？

scripts.text: That shining item you're carrying, isn't that...? ^3355FFStamp of Muriniel^000000?! Oh! What a surprise!
scripts.translation: ..你带着的那件闪亮物品，难道是^3355FF...？穆里尼尔^000000印章？！真令人惊讶！

scripts.text: I've heard that it's from a hot and dry land, but I never dreamed I'd be able to see it with my own eyes!
scripts.translation: 我听说它来自炎热干燥的土地，但我从未想过能亲眼见到它！

scripts.text: Who are you...? Who are you carrying this legendary item for?
scripts.translation: 你是谁...？你替谁保管着这件传奇物品？

scripts.text: ...I can't believe my eyes! Only a chosen few can possess the Stamp of Muriniel...
scripts.translation: ...我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛！只有少数被选中的人才能拥有穆里尼尔印章...

scripts.text: Oh yes. That's right, that's right. As far as I can tell, you don't seem to understand how to use this item...
scripts.translation: 哦，是的，没错，没错。据我观察，你似乎并不了解如何使用这个物品...

scripts.text: There is one old song in Juno, about ^3355FF'The Doomed Sword'^000000 that you may have been looking for.
scripts.translation: 朱诺有一首古老的歌谣，关^3355FF于“命运之剑”^000000，也许你一直在寻找的就是它。

scripts.text: 'Even if you're running toward a light on the other side of the mist, you can't reach it.'
scripts.translation: “即使奔向迷雾彼端的光，也无法抵达。”

scripts.text: 'The chime of the bell from across the valley cannot be held in your hand.'
scripts.translation: “山谷对岸传来的钟声，无法握在手中。”

scripts.text: Yes, it's sort of a difficult song to understand, but it's supposed to express how Sages in ancient times feel about obtaining the doomed swords.
scripts.translation: 是的，这首歌确实很难懂，但据说它表达了古代贤者对获得命运之剑一事的感受。

scripts.text: If you're still set on the idea of obtaining the doomed sword, come and talk to me sometime.
scripts.translation: 如果你仍然坚持要获得命运之剑，随时可以来找我谈谈。

scripts.text: As you already possess the Stamp of Muriniel, I am more than willing to help you.
scripts.translation: 既然你已经拥有了穆里尼尔印章，我非常乐意帮助你。

scripts.text: A genius you say? How can you say that in a city full of wise men? That's nothing special.
scripts.translation: 你说你是天才？在一个充满智者的城市里，这算什么特别的事？

scripts.text: Plus, if you're a colleague, I think I would remember you. I don't tend to forget people that I've met at least once.
scripts.translation: 而且，如果你是我的同事，我想我会记得你。我通常不会忘记至少见过一次面的人。

scripts.text: I don't understand what you're talking about. But there's an ancient Juno song about this GM you speak of...
scripts.translation: 我不明白你在说什么。不过，朱诺有一首关于你所说的GM的古老歌谣...

scripts.text: '^FF3355Impersonating GMs is punishable with a permanent account block^000000.' But what could it possibly mean?
scripts.translation: ^FF3355“冒充GM者将被永久封号。”但这^000000到底是什么意思呢？

scripts.text: Hmm! Good job, you brought all of the items. Try inserting them in the grooves.
scripts.translation: 嗯！干得好，你把所有物品都带来了。试着把它们插进凹槽里。

scripts.text: To be honest, I thought about it before, but this is the first time that I'll actually try this experiment. Go ahead, I want to see what happens!
scripts.translation: 说实话，我之前想过这个问题，但这是我第一次真正尝试这个实验。继续吧，我想看看会发生什么！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou hear a strange sound come from inside the statue.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你听到雕像内部传来奇怪的声^000000音。

scripts.text: ^3355FFA small hole opened near the foot of the statue, and a ^9999FF Stamp of Muriniel^3355FF came out of the hole.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雕像脚边开了一个小孔，一枚穆^9999FF里尼尔印章^3355FF从孔中弹了出^000000来。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou got ^9999FFA piece from the Stamp of Muriniel^3355FF.^000000
Huh?! That piece seems to fit to the stamp you have. Why don't you try joining them together?
scripts.translation: 咦？！那个碎片似乎能和你手上的印章拼合。试着把它们拼在一起吧。
^3355FF你将两块印章碎片拼合在一^000000起。

scripts.text: Oh? This pattern is...!! Ah, now I see how it works. Now, please listen...
scripts.translation: 哦？这个图案是...！！啊，我明白它的用途了。现在请听我说...

scripts.text: I'd like you to bring the slate to Snotora, the island of knowledge, that is a part of Juno. You will find a Statue of the Goddess Snotora somewhere on the island.
scripts.translation: 请把石板带到朱诺所属的知识之岛斯诺托拉。你会在岛上找到一尊斯诺托拉女神像。

scripts.text: Near the statue, you will find ^3355FFSyklah^000000, one of well-known 3 sages in Juno. Speak to him, he will tell you something about the pattern on the slate.
scripts.translation: 雕像附近有西克拉^3355FF，朱诺^000000三位著名贤者之一。和他谈谈，他会告诉你石板上图案的含义。

scripts.text: Let me tell you everything I know about the doomed sword. There's an old song about the legendary doomed sword...
scripts.translation: 让我把关于命运之剑的事都告诉你。关于这把传奇的命运之剑，有一首古老歌谣...

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou, the one with sincere faith, who humbly accepts the prosperity of Mineta, the knowledge of Snotora and the honor of Solomon...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你，心怀虔诚信念之人，谦逊地接受米内塔的繁荣、斯诺托拉的知识和所罗门的荣耀.^000000..

scripts.text: ^3355FFI hereby grant you this column of light. The Three Sages of Juno will be your guide^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我在此授予你这道光柱。朱诺的三位贤者将为你指引方^000000向。

scripts.text: Well, if you already know a little bit about Juno, you'd know that Juno consists of 3 islands that represent propsperity, knowledge and honor.
scripts.translation: 你对朱诺有所了解的话，应该知道朱诺由三座岛屿组成，分别代表繁荣、知识和荣耀。

scripts.text: The 3 sages described in the song represent each island. By now, you've probably guessed that I am one of them.
scripts.translation: 歌谣中描述的三位贤者分别代表这三座岛屿。到现在，你大概已经猜到我就是其中之一了。

scripts.text: There is a Juno tradition in which the three best Sages are chosen to represent each of Juno's islands.
scripts.translation: 朱诺有一个传统，选出三位最优秀的贤者来代表朱诺的三座岛屿。

scripts.text: As one of the three, I will serve as one of your guides in this part of your journey for the doomed sword.
scripts.translation: 作为三位贤者之一，我将成为你的向导，陪你踏上寻找命运之剑的旅程。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYklah pointed at a pole of the statue with his finger, and you see that there is a strange pattern engraved on the pole.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF伊克拉用手指指向雕像的一根柱子，你看到柱子上刻着奇怪的图^000000案。

scripts.text: Now, look at this. This statue was erected to pay tribute to one of the first 3 sages. When you look into the bottom of the pole, you will see several small grooves.
scripts.translation: 看这里。这座雕像是为了纪念最早的三位贤者之一而建的。看柱子底部，会发现几个小凹槽。

scripts.text: If you insert some items in the grooves, we may get some more clues relating to the doomed sword.
scripts.translation: 如果把一些物品放进凹槽，我们也许能找到更多与命运之剑有关的线索。

scripts.text: From the stories that I've been told by great Sages, I've figured exactly which items you'll need to place into those grooves.
scripts.translation: 根据我从贤者那里听来的故事，我已经弄清楚该把哪些物品放进凹槽了。

scripts.text: Return once you have obtained those items, and we will speak of the doomed sword again.
scripts.translation: 等你获得这些物品后再回来，我们将再次讨论命运之剑。

scripts.text: For your information, you can obtain the claw of desert wolf from the Morocc desert, and the tooth of bat can be found in most caves around the world.
scripts.translation: 告诉你一声，沙漠之狼指甲可以在梦罗克沙漠找到，蝙蝠牙则能在世界各地的大多数洞穴里找到。

scripts.text: Lastly, the piece of egg shell can be found from solid egg monsters in the Payon cave.
scripts.translation: 最后，蛋壳碎片可以从斐扬洞穴里的实蛋魔物身上获得。

scripts.text: From the stories that I've been told by great Sages, I've figured exactly which items you'll need to place into those grooves.
scripts.translation: 根据我从贤者那里听来的故事，我已经弄清楚该把哪些物品放进凹槽了。

scripts.text: Return once you have obtained those items, and we will speak of the doomed sword again.
scripts.translation: 等你获得这些物品后再回来，我们将再次讨论命运之剑。

scripts.text: For your information, you can obtain the claw of desert wolf from the Morocc desert, and the tooth of bat can be found in most caves around the world.
scripts.translation: 告诉你一声，沙漠之狼指甲可以在梦罗克沙漠找到，蝙蝠牙则能在世界各地的大多数洞穴里找到。

scripts.text: Lastly, the piece of egg shell can be found from solid egg monsters in the Payon cave.
scripts.translation: 最后，蛋壳碎片可以从斐扬洞穴里的实蛋魔物身上获得。

scripts.text: That was the name of the city that once existed in ancient times.
scripts.translation: 这是远古时代一座城市的名字。

scripts.text: The most intelligent and talented people of that time lived there, harnessing the pieces of Ymir's heart to power their civilization.
scripts.translation: 当时最聪明、最有才华的人都住在那里，利用依美乐之心的碎片驱动他们的文明。

scripts.text: Unfortunately, they happened to abuse that great power and somehow destroyed themselves.
scripts.translation: 不幸的是，他们滥用了那股强大的力量，最终毁灭了自己。

scripts.text: If you long to acquire God's knowledge, you must first be humble. Otherwise...
scripts.translation: 如果你渴望获得神明的知识，就必须先保持谦逊。否则...

scripts.text: Can it be the Stamp of Muriniel?
scripts.translation: 难道是穆里尼尔印章吗？

scripts.text: Now, we shall battle to the death to see if you are worthy of possessing this item. Prepare yourself!
scripts.translation: 现在我们要较量一番，看看你是否配得上拥有这件物品。准备好！

scripts.text: Muhahahahaha!!! Don't worry, I was only messing with you. Yklah told me that you might be coming.
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈哈哈！！！别担心，我只是在逗你玩。伊克拉说你可能会来。

scripts.text: It is said that The Stamp of Muriniel chooses its owner by its own will, and will not appear otherwise.
scripts.translation: 据说穆里尼尔印章会凭自己的意志选择主人，否则它不会显现。

scripts.text: Even though I am one of the three great Sages of Juno, I've never even seen this item before.
scripts.translation: 虽然我身为朱诺三大贤者之一，但我从未见过这件物品。

scripts.text: Yklah gave me an idea about the Stamp of Muriniel you've brought, so we'll try it out as well.
scripts.translation: 伊克拉告诉了我你带来的穆里尼尔印章的事，我们也来试试看。

scripts.text: The pattern engraved on the Stamp of Muriniel has shapes that are similar to the pattern engraved on this^3355FFStatue of the Goddess Snotora^000000.
scripts.translation: 穆里尼尔印章上的图案，与这座斯诺托拉女神像^3355FF上的图案形状相^000000似。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou see for yourself that, indeed, the pattern on the statue of the Goddess Snotora matches that on the Stamp of Muriniel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你亲眼看到，斯诺托拉女神像上的图案确实与穆里尼尔印章上的图案相^000000符。

scripts.text: When I was young, I learned about a legendary stamp ink related to this statue. But at the time, it made no sense to me. Just how legendary can stamp ink be?
scripts.translation: 我年轻时听说过一种与这尊雕像有关的传奇印泥。当时我觉得这毫无意义：印泥能有多传奇？

scripts.text: But now I believe that this stamping ink can be used with this Stamp of Muriniel.
scripts.translation: 但现在我相信，这种印泥可以配合穆里尼尔印章使用。

scripts.text: But even though I've learned how to make this special stamping ink, it is too difficult for me to collect the materials that are necessary to create it.
scripts.translation: 虽然我学会了制作这种特殊印泥，但收集制作所需的材料对我来说太难了。

scripts.text: Okay, if you're ready, please bring me the following items. I feel like making legendary red ink, so bring me...
scripts.translation: 好了，如果你准备好了，请带给我以下物品。我想制作传奇红色印泥，所以请带来...

scripts.text: The Stone Heart will be used as a bottle to hold this special ink.
scripts.translation: 石心会被用作容器，盛放这种特殊印泥。

scripts.text: I think that's all I need. Anyway, I believe that gathering these items shouldn't be a difficult task for you. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation: 我想这就是全部所需物品了。总之，收集这些东西对你来说应该不难。祝你好运。

scripts.text: So you've already gathered the items I've asked for. Good, good. Let's get started...
scripts.translation: 原来你已经集齐了我要求的物品。很好，很好。开始吧...

scripts.text: ^3355FFSage Syklah grinded the stones and stone heart and molded them into a strange shape.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF贤者西克拉把石头和石心磨碎，再塑成奇特的形^000000状。

scripts.text: ^3355FFHe then ground the red herbs and placed them into the stone mold.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF接着，他把红色药草磨碎，放进石模^000000里。

scripts.text: ^3355FFAfterwards, he then took a strangely shaped capsule from his pocket, sprinkled some liquid from it, and began to chant a spell...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF随后，他从口袋里拿出一个形状奇特的胶囊，洒出一些液体，并开始吟唱咒语.^000000..

scripts.text: Doo de doo de~ Dah dah dah Dan dan dan Dah dah dah! Nu ha nu ha nu hahaha... Moo hee moo hee moo hee~
scripts.translation: Doo de doo de~ Dah dah dah 当 当 当 Dah dah dah! Nu ha nu ha nu 哈哈哈... Moo hee moo hee moo hee~

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe Stamping Ink of Muriniel has been created, and has been given to you by the sage Syklah.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF穆里尼尔印泥已经制作完成，并由贤者西克拉交给^000000你。

scripts.text: Now, with this stamping ink, you are able to use the Stamp of Muriniel.
scripts.translation: 现在，有了这种墨水，你就可以使用穆里尼尔印章了。

scripts.text: Now, I don't think you can use the stamp just anywhere. After all, it is a legendary item.
scripts.translation: 我想你不能随便在任何地方使用这个印章。毕竟，它是一件传奇物品。

scripts.text: Please visit the Third Sage ^3355FFEsklah^000000 who stays on Solomon, the island of prosperity, here in Juno.
scripts.translation: 请去拜访居住在^3355FF朱诺繁^000000荣之岛所罗门的第三位贤者埃斯克拉。

scripts.text: He will be able to tell you more about where to use this stamp. However, be careful. He is the most fastidious sage among all of us.
scripts.translation: 他能告诉你更多关于印章该在哪里使用。不过要小心，他是我们当中最吹毛求疵的贤者。

scripts.text: I hope you will bring me what I need to make the 'Stamp of Muriniel' ink soon.
scripts.translation: 希望你能尽快带给我制作穆里尼尔印泥所需的材料。

scripts.text: Please visit ^3355FFEsklah^000000 on the island of prosperity, Solomon. But be careful. He is the most exacting Sage out of all of us.
scripts.translation: 请去繁^3355FF荣之岛所^000000罗门拜访埃斯克拉。但要小心，他是我们当中最严苛的贤者。

scripts.text: The people here keep talking of some suspicious man living in Juno.
scripts.translation: 这里的人一直在谈论一个住在朱诺的可疑男子。

scripts.text: Supposedly, he's pretty dangerous, and is always immersing himself in some kind of research.
scripts.translation: 据说他相当危险，总是沉浸在某项研究中。

scripts.text: People already consider him a 'Mad Scientist,' wasting his time studying impractical things beyond the understanding of normal people.
scripts.translation: 人们已经称他为“疯狂科学家”，说他把时间浪费在研究那些超出常人理解的不切实际事物上。

scripts.text: It's rumored that this scientist is responsible for creating 'Blazer,' a monster made of magic flame.
scripts.translation: 传闻这位科学家创造了“火焰妖”，一种由魔法火焰构成的魔物。

scripts.text: It's a dangerous and fearsome monster that casts spells like Fire Bolt and Fire Ball that lives outside of Juno.
scripts.translation: 这是一种危险可怕的魔物，住在朱诺城外，会施放火箭术、火球术等法术。

scripts.text: You must be the one who holds the Stamp of Muriniel...
scripts.translation: 你就是持有穆里尼尔印章的人吧...

scripts.text: Heh, you don't look like much. But even though you're ordinary looking, you possess the legendary item!
scripts.translation: 呵，你看起来平平无奇。但尽管外表普通，你却拥有这件传奇物品！

scripts.text: Only a few people in Midgard's history have been chosen to use the ^3355FFStamp of Muriniel.^000000
scripts.translation: 在米德加尔特历史上，只有少数人被选中^3355FF使用穆里尼尔印^000000章。

scripts.text: However, it's my job to test whether or not you are truly qualified to possess it.
scripts.translation: 然而，我的职责是测试你是否真正有资格拥有它。

scripts.text: Let me tell you about the stamp craftman ^3355FFMuriniel^000000.
scripts.translation: 让我给你讲讲印章工匠穆里^3355FF尼尔的故^000000事。

scripts.text: This man lived long ago, somewhere in Mt. Mjornir. He was eager in his studies, and wanted to recreate every pattern that existed in the world.
scripts.translation: 很久以前，他住在米约尼尔山一带。他勤于钻研，想要重现世上所有的图案。

scripts.text: Believing that people were obstacles to his study of patterns, he lived in seclusion, studying alone.
scripts.translation: 他认为人类是他研究图案的障碍，于是隐居起来，独自钻研。

scripts.text: While studying patterns one day, he happened to find a magic circle that connected this world to another world.
scripts.translation: 有一天，他在研究图案时，偶然发现了一个连接此界与另一世界的魔法阵。

scripts.text: That circle was totally different from ones used by Mages, Wizards or sages. This pattern had the power to summon an evil creature from the other world.
scripts.translation: 那个魔法阵与魔法师、巫师或贤者使用的阵法截然不同。这个图案能够从异世界召唤邪恶生物。

scripts.text: In order to summon the creature, the pattern must be created in the perfect location. Muriniel began to explore various places and finally found the spot he was looking for.
scripts.translation: 要召唤那个生物，必须在合适的地点绘制图案。穆里尼尔开始四处探寻，终于找到了理想之地。

scripts.text: The place he found is now ^3355FFMuriniel's Cottage^000000. But to see that place, you will first need the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation: 他找到的地方就^3355FF是现在的穆里尼^000000尔小屋。但要看到那个地方，你首先^3355FF需要穆里尼尔罗^000000盘。

scripts.text: Heh heh. That's right, making the Compass of Muriniel will be my test for you.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿.。没错，制作穆里尼尔罗盘就是我对你的考验。

scripts.text: Now listen carefully, I won't tell you more than once. I will need you to collect some items to make the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation: 现在仔细听着，我只说一次。我需要你收集一些物品来制^3355FF作穆里尼尔罗^000000盘。

scripts.text: For someone seeking the doomed sword, this should be a relatively simple task. Now go, and bring me what I have asked.
scripts.translation: 对于寻找命运之剑的人来说，这应该是个相对简单的任务。去吧，把我要求的物品带回来。

scripts.text: Good work. Now, while I make the body of the compass, you can go and bring me the rest of the items I'll need.
scripts.translation: 干得好。现在，趁我制作罗盘主体的时候，你可以去把我需要的其余物品带回来。

scripts.text: Muhahahaha! What's with that look? You know how this kind of business gets done!
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈哈！你那是什么表情？你知道这类事情就是这么办的！

scripts.text: Now listen carefully. I won't tell you more than once. I need some items to create the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation: 现在仔细听着，我只说一次。我需要一些物品来制^3355FF作穆里尼尔罗^000000盘。

scripts.text: Now let me get to work.
^3355FFSage Esklah handed you the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF贤者埃斯克拉递给^3355FF了你穆里尼尔罗^000000盘。

scripts.text: ^3355FFIn the direction the compass is pointing, some words are engraved...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在罗盘指向的方向，刻着一些文字.^000000..

scripts.text: Look at the middle of compass carefully to find the place you must use the stamp. I wish you the best of luck in your journey.
scripts.translation: 请仔细观察罗盘的中心，找到你需要使用印章的地方。祝你在旅途中好运。

scripts.text: Muhahaha! Now, get a move on!
^3355FFYou look into the compass of Muriniel and take note of the engraving...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你凝视着穆里尼尔罗盘，并记下上面的刻痕.^000000..

scripts.text: As I was thinking of how wonderfully poetic that image was, that paper suddenly attacked me! Me, one of Juno's greatest Sages!
scripts.translation: 我正想着那画面多么富有诗意，那张纸突然就攻击了我！我可是朱诺最伟大的贤者之一啊！

scripts.text: I tried defending myself with my trusty sword, but being paper-thin, that monster managed to dodge all of my blows. I had to cast magic in order to destroy it.
scripts.translation: 我试着用信赖的剑抵挡，但那魔物薄如纸片，躲开了我所有的攻击。我只好施展魔法将它消灭。

scripts.text: Later, I learned that monster is known as ^3355FFThe Paper^000000.
scripts.translation: 后来，我得知那魔物被称为纸^^3355FF00000^0000000妖。

scripts.text: It used to be a part of an old book that contained a lot of ancient knowledge about Juno, but somehow, became a monster. Isn't that peculiar?
scripts.translation: 它原本是一本古书的一部分，那本书记载着许多朱诺的古代知识，不知为何它却变成了魔物。真奇怪，不是吗？

scripts.text: ^3355FFMuriniel's pattern is carved into the wooden floor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF穆里尼尔的图案刻在木地板^000000上。

scripts.text: ^3355FFUsing the ^9999FFStamp of Muriniel^3355FF and the ^9999FFStamping Ink of Muriniel^3355FF, you fit the stamp into the pattern on the floor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你用穆^9999FF里尼尔印章^3355FF和穆里^9999FF尼尔印泥，将^3355FF印章按在地板上的图案中^000000。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou can faintly hear someone's voice softly in the distance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你隐约听到远处传来某人的声音^000000。

scripts.text: You, who are in the future, let me introduce myself.
scripts.translation: 身处未来的你，请容我自我介绍。

scripts.text: My name is Muriniel, the stamp craftman living in your past. I appreciate that you have overcome many obstacles to reach this place.
scripts.translation: 我是穆里尼尔，来自你们过去的印章工匠。感谢你克服重重障碍来到这里。

scripts.text: However, you must first prove that you are qualified to wield the great power of the doomed sword.
scripts.translation: 不过，你必须先证明自己有资格驾驭命运之剑的强大力量。

scripts.text: The great Sages in Juno have helped me to install this magical system in my cottage to leave my message to you, adventurer in the future.
scripts.translation: 朱诺的贤者们帮我在小屋里安装了这套魔法装置，好让我把留言留给未来的冒险者。

scripts.text: I know that you seek more power by obtaining a doomed sword. But not just anyone can handle the might of a doomed sword.
scripts.translation: 我知道你想得到命运之剑以获得更强大的力量。但并非谁都能驾驭命运之剑的威力。

scripts.text: And I shudder to think what would happen if such power were to fall into evil hands. The test I have prepared cannot begin until Autumn follows a hot summer.
scripts.translation: 一想到这股力量落入邪恶之手会酿成什么后果，我就不寒而栗。我准备的考验，要等炎夏过后、秋天到来时才能开始。

scripts.text: I shall give you an item that promises you of the quest I will give you in the future. Return to this place when the trees begin to shed their leaves...
scripts.translation: 我会给你一件物品，作为未来交给你任务的凭证。等树木开始落叶时，再回到这里...

scripts.text: Until that time comes, prepare yourself. And stay alive.
scripts.translation: 在那之前，做好准备。活下去。

scripts.text: ^3355FFSuddenly, the Stamp of Muriniel and the Compass of Muriniel break open to reveal a small, shining object.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF突然，穆里尼尔的印章和穆里尼尔的罗盘裂开，露出了一个闪闪发光的小物^000000件。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou can faintly hear someone's voice coming from somewhere...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你隐约听到某人的声音从某处传来.^000000..

scripts.text: Please remember to return to this place when the trees begin to shed their leaves. Until then, prepare yourself and stay alive.
scripts.translation: 请记住，当树木开始落叶时回到这里。在那之前，做好准备，活下去。

scripts.text: ^3355FFFor some reason, that message is written in this place. But what could be so significant about a cottage like this?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF不知为何，这条信息写在这个地方。但这间小屋有什么特别之处^000000吗？
